say:2:1630116001:1.text: Results don't mean a thing if you cut corners to get them. No shortcuts. Understood?
say:2:1630116001:1.source_cn: 不论成绩如何，都不可以走捷径，明白吗？

say:3:1630116002:1.text: Everything that looks free usually isn't. There's always a cost—you just don't see it. And sometimes, you can't afford what it really takes.
say:3:1630116002:1.source_cn: 所有的馈赠都在暗中标注好了价格。那些天上掉馅饼的事，肯...

say:6:1630116004:1.text: If you want to get better at magic, do the work. There are no shortcuts.
say:6:1630116004:1.source_cn: 学习魔法一定要脚踏实地……

choice_prompt:7:1630116004.text: If you want to get better at magic, do the work. There are no shortcuts.
choice_prompt:7:1630116004.source_cn: 学习魔法一定要脚踏实地……

say:8:1630116005:1.text: No. She made her choice. And she paid for it.
say:8:1630116005:1.source_cn: 不，每个人都要为自己做出的选择负责。
say:8:1630116005:1.male: No. She made her choice. And she paid for it.
say:8:1630116005:1.female: No. She made her choice. And she paid for it.

say:9:1630116006:1.text: I wouldn't say I felt sorry for her... I was just... shocked. We saw her every day. Then suddenly, she was gone, like she'd never been here at all.
say:9:1630116006:1.source_cn: 我没有为她哀伤过……只是那时有些不敢置信，毕竟是每天都...
say:9:1630116006:1.male: I wouldn't say I felt sorry for her... I was just... shocked. We saw her every day. Then suddenly, she was gone, like she'd never been here at all.
say:9:1630116006:1.female: I wouldn't say I felt sorry for her... I was just... shocked. We saw her every day. Then suddenly, she was gone, like she'd never been here at all.

say:10:1630116007:1.text: What happened to her made me realize something: I don't want to end up like that. And more than anything, I want to help others stay on the right path.
say:10:1630116007:1.source_cn: 嘉丽的事情让我明白了很多。现在，我更想做一个能够告诫后...
say:10:1630116007:1.male: What happened to her made me realize something: I don't want to end up like that. And more than anything, I want to help others stay on the right path.
say:10:1630116007:1.female: What happened to her made me realize something: I don't want to end up like that. And more than anything, I want to help others stay on the right path.

say:11:1630116008:1.text: I've started working on my thesis. If I can, I'd like to stay at the Lyceum and teach.
say:11:1630116008:1.source_cn: 我已经在准备论文了，希望毕业后能留在莱希拉姆做老师。
say:11:1630116008:1.male: I've started working on my thesis. If I can, I'd like to stay at the Lyceum and teach.
say:11:1630116008:1.female: I've started working on my thesis. If I can, I'd like to stay at the Lyceum and teach.

say:12:1630116009:1.text: Magic's not easy. If I can help even one person avoid the mistakes we've seen... that's worth it.
say:12:1630116009:1.source_cn: 学习魔法的路并非坦途，我想帮助他们。最起码不要走偏了方向。
say:12:1630116009:1.male: Magic's not easy. If I can help even one person avoid the mistakes we've seen... that's worth it.
say:12:1630116009:1.female: Magic's not easy. If I can help even one person avoid the mistakes we've seen... that's worth it.
